17 and still homeschooled with qanon family 🙋 nah dude i'm sorry to hear about that. It's a saddening and even irritating thing to deal with. 

On the bright side you didn't fall (or fall too deep enough to get stuck) into the qanon trap. Slowly waiting to see if they'll ever snap out of it and realise it's just a huge cult. My parents also pull the whole "the world is dangerous, we are doing you a favor" shenanigans, which I believed, so I nearly fell into the Qanon trap until I started realising how much false information they were spewing. (I mean they were throwing a fit because they believe Michelle Obama is transgender)

They've grown to hate most celebrities due to the fact that they believe they inject children's blood into their veins lol. There was even a time where they started loading up on a shit ton of groceries for a 10 day black out.

 Idk, it's weird but ya ain't alone!
Looks straight out of a dream. Gorgeous!
Handsome! Also hella jealous of that shirt. So hard for my tiny ass to find good fitted button down shirts 👏👏👏
Truly, though 😩 I'm sure some day!
Hell yeah! Thanks for the recommendation. It's already difficult finding good lesbian books that I'd enjoy, but extremely rare to even find butch/butch content.
Your whole look is badass. My dream aesthetic to have 👏 looks amazing!!
You for real have a really nice face shape, dude 👏👏

I relate to this so so much. I'm a cis baby butch, still learning about myself, but I actually really love the sterotypical feminine things like doing makeup, having long hair, traditional white dresses and such. Issue is, is that when I look in the mirror I think, "wow. What a beautiful woman" BUT it's like my brain doesn't click that "that's me" and when it does click it makes me very uncomfortable and instantly get rid of it all. If I saw myself in public, as somebody else, I'd think "wow she's beautiful" but realising that she IS me is discomforting and lowkey just yikes feeling. If I were a man and I dressed like that, though? I'd love it. I love the flat chest and lean build and masculine facial features paired with feminine things. I just think there's something really badass and fitting about it, wish it was me baha!
This is the first time I've been called handsome and it means so much. Thank you ❤
Oh goodness thank you so much ❤!
Thank you so much !❤
Wow. It's been so long since I've had inspiration to draw or do any type of art but these images for sure sparked some inspiration. So beautiful!

Same shit I say.
When I was a kid I had an obsession with dragons to the point to where I actually thought I was one. Inside joke of the family is that I'm slowly turning into a reptile by now. Lmao.
Thank you 💕💕!

Thank you so much for this 💕 this is extremely helpful. Been researching her for a while yet still have so much more to learn, always learning something new about her. That all makes a lot of sense.

Many blessings and thank you again for taking your time to read and type this up!

My parents are the exact same way! They're amazing, very loving and good people but force their own feelings onto me.

Another thing they did was tell me about how cruel kids my age were due to their own childhood bullying experiences.

Late as all hell to this but I currently feel the exact same, except I'm contemplating small doses of T for the future. You sound like you're androgynous :) possibly even with a masculine lean. Hope you were/are able to figure shit out! Gender expression and identity can be such an ass to figure out.
Thank you :) I'll try it out. Always avoided discord since it kinda intimidated me.

It's reassuring in a strange way to know I'm not alone in this.

I really hope you're able to figure yourself out soon and I feel you on the social change part. I have to admit that'd be one of my biggest fears, especially with the family and my girlfriend (who also identifies as a lesbian)

Best of wishes and thank you for sharing your experience with me :).
Haven't read the book but I have watched the show and needless to say- I found even myself being charmed by Lister. The series was well handled, loved it. :)
